A '''''bevii'ragir''''' was a traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Spear/Legends|spear]]. Built strong enough to support the weight of an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], with a removable counterbalance weight located at the end opposite to the pointed tip, a ''bevii'ragir'' could function as both a dangerous weapon and a supportive walking stick.<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] deserter, [[Fi Skirata]], was given a ''bevii'ragir'' by his girlfriend [[Parja Bralor]], during his [[Time/Legends|time]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Skirata had suffered [[Brain/Legends|brain]] damage during an [[Battle of Gaftikar|operation]] on [[Gaftikar]] while he was still in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|service]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and used the ''bevii'ragir'' to support himself when he walked in public. He believed using the hunting spear afforded him a more dignified appearance than crutches or a [[Cane/Legends|cane]].<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''bevii'ragir'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].

The novel also mentions an ancient [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] spear worn by the Mandalorian ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Wad'e Tay'haai]] on the back of his [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. However, Tay'haai's spear was not specifically referred to as a ''bevii'ragir'' and context from the novel is unclear as to whether the weapon was specifically intended to be a ''bevii'ragir''. This article assumes Tay'haai's spear is of a different design pending further clarification.
